faq.q: How long does a ceramic coating last?
faq.a: Our packages are rated 2, 5 or 9 years with the maintenance washes in your care guide, and each comes with a written warranty.

faq.q: Do I need paint correction before coating?
faq.a: Usually yes. A coating locks in whatever is under it, so we polish out swirls first. The free inspection tells you how much your paint needs.

faq.q: How long will you have my car?
faq.a: One to three days depending on the package. We send progress photos and can arrange a loaner ride.

faq.q: Can I still wash it myself?
faq.a: Yes, with a pH-neutral soap. Your care guide shows how, or book our coating-safe maintenance wash.
Yes. Any package can be split into 12 equal payments with no interest; the monthly prices are under the 12 payments toggle above.
